description: This source file contains fuzz testing code for the Android Audio Policy Manager, including classes and functions to generate and test various audio configurations, device connections, and policy behaviors using fuzzed input data.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzer
classes.description: Main class for fuzzing the Android Audio Policy Manager, providing methods to initialize, configure, and generate audio patches based on fuzzed input.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerWithConfigurationFile
classes.description: Derived class that loads and applies custom XML configurations for testing different audio policy setups.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerMsd
classes.description: Subclass that loads specific MSD (Media Stream Description) configuration XML for testing.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerDynamicPolicy
classes.description: Handles dynamic policy rules, including adding, registering, and unregistering policy mixes.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerDPNoRemoteSubmixModule
classes.description: Specialized subclass for testing configurations without remote submix modules.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerDPPlaybackReRouting
classes.description: Tests playback rerouting policies with fuzzed parameters.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerDPMixRecordInjection
classes.description: Tests recording injection policies with fuzzed parameters.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerFuzzerDeviceConnection
classes.description: Tests device connection and routing behaviors with fuzzed data.

classes.name: AudioPolicyManagerTVFuzzer
classes.description: Tests TV-specific audio configurations and HDMI port selection.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the fuzzing environment, including loading configurations and setting up the manager.

methods.name: SetUpManagerConfig
methods.description: Sets default or custom configuration for the audio policy manager.

methods.name: getOutputForAttr
methods.description: Obtains an audio output handle based on specified attributes.

methods.name: getInputForAttr
methods.description: Obtains an audio input handle based on specified attributes.

methods.name: findDevicePort
methods.description: Finds an audio port matching role, device type, and address.

methods.name: getDeviceIdFromPatch
methods.description: Extracts device ID from an audio patch.

methods.name: createFuzzedPatch
methods.description: Creates a fuzzed audio patch with random sources and sinks.

methods.name: fuzzPatchCreation
methods.description: Performs fuzz testing of patch creation and release.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point to run the fuzzing process for each class.

methods.name: getConfigFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the XML configuration file for the test.

methods.name: traverseAndFuzzXML
methods.description: Recursively modifies XML nodes to inject fuzzed values for testing.

methods.name: fuzzXML
methods.description: Loads, modifies, and saves a fuzzed XML configuration file.

methods.name: addPolicyMix
methods.description: Adds a new policy mix with specified rules and configuration.

methods.name: clearPolicyMix
methods.description: Clears all current policy mixes.

methods.name: registerPolicyMixes
methods.description: Registers current policy mixes with the manager.

methods.name: unregisterPolicyMixes
methods.description: Unregisters current policy mixes from the manager.

methods.name: playBackReRouting
methods.description: Simulates playback rerouting with fuzzed attributes.

methods.name: recordingInjection
methods.description: Simulates recording injection with fuzzed attributes.

methods.name: setDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Fuzzed method to simulate device connection state changes.

methods.name: explicitlyRoutingAfterConnection
methods.description: Fuzzed method to test routing after device connection.

methods.name: testHDMIPortSelection
methods.description: Tests HDMI port selection with fuzzed flags.
